newsitem.title: UK: Delay to Dover-Calais fast ferry entering service.
newsitem.headline: Delay to Dover-Calais fast ferry entering service.

text.p: The first sailing of the largest single hulled high speed ferry to operate on the prime cross channel route between Dover and Calais has been delayed until Wednesday, Hoverspeed said today.
The 100 metre long SuperSeaCat, which can carry 774 passengers and 175 cars at over 37 knots, was due to enter service on Tuesday for Hoverspeed, a division of Sea Containers Ltd.
A spokesman for Hoverspeed said the company was awaiting final authorisation from Italy before the ferry, which can complete the crossing in 50 minutes, is allowed to sail.

The vessel, which was built by Italian shipbuilder Fincantieri, is now expected to enter service on Wednesday, he said. The spokesman added that the vessel had obtained all necessary safety certificates.

Hoverspeed previously said that when the new vessel operates alongside its two existing hovercraft, it will be able to offer up to 21 return crossings on the short sea routes during the summer peak season. -Paul Berrill Reuters Shipping News + 44 171 542 4087. Fax 5017.
